Hey Harlo Labs Team,

I’m reaching out on behalf of BCMonster.com. We officially relaunched this past Friday, and we’re working to get the word out, grow our mining community, and build partnerships with quality companies in the Bitcoin mining space.

BCMonster has history in the mining community, and you can check out our historical BTC mining activity and blocks here:

BCMonster on mempool.space:
https://mempool.space/mining/pool/bcmonster

We’re excited to be back and building BCMonster for the next chapter. As part of our relaunch, we’d love to partner with Harlo Labs and list you as our preferred mining firmware on BCMonster.com.

We see this as a great opportunity to introduce our miners to your firmware while giving Harlo Labs additional exposure through our website and growing community. We’re happy to feature whichever link you’d prefer, whether that’s your main website, firmware download page, or a referral link.

We’re open to starting with a simple listing and building the relationship from there as both platforms grow. Our goal is to get BCMonster back out in front of the mining community and establish relationships that benefit everyone involved.

If this sounds like something you’d be interested in, we’d love to connect and discuss getting it started.

BCMonster

Hello,

Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the relaunch.

One thing worth clearing up first: you have reached HeliumDeploy, not Harlo Labs. We sell the hardware (Harlo B30, Hammer, NerdQX and NerdOctaxe, Nexus, Avalon, plus DePIN gear) and we support Harlo OS on the units we ship, but Harlo Labs is a separate outfit and the firmware itself is theirs. So a "preferred firmware" listing is really their call to make, and the quickest way to reach the people behind Harlo OS is their Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , where the Harlo OS channel is active and JD (@nullhashrate) is around most days.

On our side, a partnership or a listing is not something I can agree to from the support desk, so I have passed your note to our team. A colleague is picking it up today and will come back to you on whether a listing, a link or something broader makes sense for us.

For what it is worth, your pool is already easy to point our miners at: Harlo OS and the Bitaxe/NerdQX family take any standard stratum URL, port, worker name and password, so if you want to publish a short config snippet for those devices on BCMonster.com we are happy to sanity check the wording for you.

Thanks again for thinking of us, and good luck with the next chapter.

Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
